proof_scripts.c4-r1-real-cli-smoke.py:
"""Disposable actual-CLI/real-Node C4 proof. Synthetic fixture, never live PASS.

Parent runs this on isolated node27. Fresh private subdir per case. Uses the
shipping CLI through /usr/bin/node indirectly; freeze is full-precision then
sleep 1 before the second bracket.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
from tests.test_node27_c4_production_acceptance import write_closed_c4_fixture

REPO = Path.cwd()
CLI = [sys.executable, str(REPO / "scripts/node27_c4_production_acceptance.py")]
FRONTEND_ORIGIN = "https://display.example.test"
API_ORIGIN = "https://api.example.test"
BASIN_ID = "basins_qhh"
SEGMENT_ID = "basins_qhh_shud_reach_000001"
PARENT_MODE = 0o700
FILE_MODE = 0o600


def _private_root(prefix: str) -> Path:
    root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=prefix, dir=os.environ.get("TMPDIR") or None))
    os.chmod(root, PARENT_MODE)
    return root


def _write_approved(path: Path, sha: str) -> None:
    document = {"status": "PASS", "head_sha": sha, "reviewed_sha": sha}
    path.write_text(json.dumps(document, separators=(",", ":")))
    os.chmod(path, FILE_MODE)


def _invoke(args: list[str], *, expected: int = 0, cwd: Path | None = None) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
    result = subprocess.run(CLI + args, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30, cwd=cwd or REPO)
    assert result.returncode == expected, (result.returncode, result.stdout, result.stderr)
    return result


def _replace_same_bytes_new_inode(path: Path) -> None:
    original = path.read_bytes()
    sibling = path.with_name(f".{path.name}.replacement")
    flags = os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0)
    fd = os.open(sibling, flags, FILE_MODE)
    try:
        os.write(fd, original)
        os.fsync(fd)
        os.fchmod(fd, FILE_MODE)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    os.unlink(path)
    os.rename(sibling, path)
    os.chmod(path, FILE_MODE)


def _reserialize_same_semantics(path: Path) -> None:
    document = json.loads(path.read_text())
    rewritten = json.dumps(document, indent=2, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8")
    assert rewritten != path.read_bytes()
    os.chmod(path, 0o600)
    path.write_bytes(rewritten)
    os.chmod(path, FILE_MODE)


def case_positive_and_sha() -> dict[str, object]:
    root = _private_root("c4-cli-positive-")
    sha = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
    approved = root / "approved.json"
    receipt = root / "receipt.json"
    freeze = root / "freeze.json"
    binding = root / "binding.json"
    acceptance = root / "acceptance.json"
    _write_approved(approved, sha)
    freeze_result = _invoke(
        [
            "freeze",
            "--approved-record",
            str(approved),
            "--reviewed-sha",
            sha,
            "--receipt",
            str(receipt),
            "--frontend-origin",
            FRONTEND_ORIGIN,
            "--api-origin",
            API_ORIGIN,
            "--basin-id",
            BASIN_ID,
            "--segment-id",
            SEGMENT_ID,
            "--output",
            str(freeze),
        ]
    )
    time.sleep(1)
    start = int(time.time())
    end = start
    write_closed_c4_fixture(receipt, cmd_start=start, cmd_end=end)
    freeze_bytes = freeze.read_bytes()
    bind_result = _invoke(
        [
            "bind",
            "--freeze",
            str(freeze),
            "--reviewed-sha",
            sha,
            "--cmd-start",
            str(start),
            "--cmd-end",
            str(end),
            "--output",
            str(binding),
        ]
    )
    verify_result = _invoke(
        [
            "verify",
            "--freeze",
            str(freeze),
            "--binding",
            str(binding),
            "--reviewed-sha",
            sha,
            "--output",
            str(acceptance),
        ]
    )
    assert json.loads(acceptance.read_text())["status"] == "PASS"
    assert freeze.read_bytes() == freeze_bytes
    refused = root / "refused.json"
    wrong_sha = "a" * 40 if sha != "a" * 40 else "b" * 40
    sha_result = _invoke(
        [
            "bind",
            "--freeze",
            str(freeze),
            "--reviewed-sha",
            wrong_sha,
            "--cmd-start",
            str(start),
            "--cmd-end",
            str(end),
            "--output",
            str(refused),
        ],
        expected=1,
    )
    assert not refused.exists()
    assert freeze.read_bytes() == freeze_bytes
    return {
        "label": "SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_NOT_LIVE_PASS",
        "case": "positive-and-sha",
        "stdout": [freeze_result.stdout, bind_result.stdout, verify_result.stdout],
        "stderr_sha": sha_result.stderr,
        "codes": ["C4_SHA_MISMATCH"] if "C4_SHA_MISMATCH" in sha_result.stderr else [sha_result.stderr],
        "root": str(root),
    }

"""Disposable mutant proof for C4E-F2/F3 and C4SP-1. Restores exact bytes.

Parent runs this on isolated node27. Never mutate test expectations. Each
selected guard-family removal must kill the corresponding new row; sha-only
identity must kill inode/mtime; dropped closed-object/cross-freeze/input
checks must kill the matching F3 row; closed-stdout reds against original CLI.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path.cwd()
OWNER = REPO / "services/production_closure/c4_production_acceptance.py"
IO = REPO / "services/production_closure/c4_production_acceptance_io.py"
CLI = REPO / "scripts/node27_c4_production_acceptance.py"
BOUNDARIES = "tests/test_node27_c4_production_acceptance_boundaries.py"
PYTEST = [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q"]


def _run(tests: list[str]) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
    return subprocess.run([*PYTEST, *tests], cwd=REPO, text=True, timeout=180, capture_output=True)


def _assert_red(result: subprocess.CompletedProcess[str], label: str) -> None:
    if result.returncode != 1 or "FAILED " not in result.stdout or "ERROR collecting" in result.stdout or "ERROR at setup" in result.stdout:
        raise SystemExit(f"{label} did not produce assertion-red:\n{result.stdout}\n{result.stderr}")
    print(result.stdout)


def _replace_once(path: Path, old: str, new: str) -> None:
    text = path.read_text()
    if old not in text:
        raise SystemExit(f"anchor missing in {path}: {old!r}")
    if text.count(old) != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f"anchor not unique in {path}: {old!r} count={text.count(old)}")
    path.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1))


def mutate(path: Path, old: str, new: str, tests: list[str], label: str) -> None:
    original = path.read_bytes()
    try:
        _replace_once(path, old, new)
        red = _run(tests)
        _assert_red(red, label)
    finally:
        path.write_bytes(original)
        if path.read_bytes() != original:
            raise SystemExit(f"{path} was not restored exactly")
    print(f"RED {label}")


def main() -> int:
    f2 = [f"{BOUNDARIES}::test_public_boundary_parameter_batch_refuses_without_publication"]
    inode = [f"{BOUNDARIES}::test_verify_refuses_same_byte_inode_replacement_after_bind"]
    utime = [f"{BOUNDARIES}::test_verify_refuses_utime_only_receipt_drift_after_bind"]
    missing = [f"{BOUNDARIES}::test_bind_refuses_absent_freeze_without_binding"]
    cross = [f"{BOUNDARIES}::test_verify_refuses_valid_cross_freeze_binding"]
    edited = [f"{BOUNDARIES}::test_verify_refuses_edited_valid_binding_input"]
    extra = [f"{BOUNDARIES}::test_verify_refuses_extra_key_freeze"]
    closed = [f"{BOUNDARIES}::test_cli_closed_stdout_after_success_keeps_published_artifact"]

    mutate(
        IO,
        'SHA_RE = r"^[0-9a-f]{40}$"',
        'SHA_RE = r"^[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$"',
        f2,
        "F2 sha-family",
    )
    origin_text = IO.read_text()
    origin_start = origin_text.index("def require_origin(")
    origin_end = origin_text.index("def require_id(", origin_start)
    mutate(
        IO,
        origin_text[origin_start:origin_end],
        "def require_origin(value: object) -> str:\n    return value\n\n\n",
        f2,
        "F2 origin-family",
    )
    mutate(
        IO,
        """def require_id(value: object, *, code: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or _ID_COMPILED.fullmatch(value) is None:
        refuse("identifier is empty or not a bounded token", code)
    return value
""",
        """def require_id(value: object, *, code: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        refuse("identifier is empty or not a bounded token", code)
    return value
""",
        f2,
        "F2 id-family",
    )
    mutate(
        IO,
        """    if start > end:
        refuse("command bracket is not a finite ordered integer pair", "C4_BRACKET_INVALID")
    return start, end
""",
        """    return start, end
""",
        f2,
        "F2 bracket-family",
    )
    mutate(
        IO,
        """def require_absolute_path(value: object, *, code: str) -> Path:
    if isinstance(value, str):

    elif isinstance(value, os.PathLike):
        text = os.fspath(value)
    else:

    if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.startswith("/") or "\\x00" in text:

    if path != normalized_absolute_path(path):

    del code
    if isinstance(value, str):

    else:
        text = str(value)
    return Path(text)
""",
        f2,
        "F2 path-family",
    )
    mutate(
        IO,
        """        if opened.st_size > max_bytes or opened.st_size < 1:
            refuse("file size is outside the bounded ceiling", "C4_TOO_LARGE")
""",
        """        if opened.st_size < 1:
            refuse("file size is outside the bounded ceiling", "C4_TOO_LARGE")
""",
        f2,
        "F2 size-family",
    )

    mutate(
        OWNER,
        """    if observed != expected:
        refuse("original file identity drifted", code)
""",
        """    if observed.sha256 != expected.sha256:
        refuse("original file identity drifted", code)
""",
        inode + utime,
        "F3 sha-only identity",
    )
    mutate(
        IO,
        """        except FileNotFoundError:
            refuse("path is unavailable", "C4_MISSING")
""",
        """        except FileNotFoundError:
            refuse("path cannot be opened without following", "C4_OPEN")
""",
        missing,
        "F3 missing-freeze coded guard",
    )
    mutate(
        OWNER,
        """    if bound_freeze_path != freeze_path:
        refuse("binding does not name the original freeze", "C4_FREEZE_MISMATCH")
    _assert_identity_match(freeze_identity, bound_freeze_identity, code="C4_FREEZE_MISMATCH")
    _assert_parent_match(freeze_parent, bound_freeze_parent, code="C4_FREEZE_MISMATCH")
""",
        """    if bound_freeze_path != freeze_path:
        pass
""",
        cross,
        "F3 dropped cross-freeze check",
    )
    mutate(
        OWNER,
        """    if inputs != bound_inputs:
        refuse("binding inputs drifted from the original freeze", "C4_INPUT_MISMATCH")
""",
        """    if False and inputs != bound_inputs:
        refuse("binding inputs drifted from the original freeze", "C4_INPUT_MISMATCH")
""",
        edited,
        "F3 dropped input-mismatch check",
    )
    mutate(
        OWNER,
        """    mapping = _require_closed_object(document, _FREEZE_KEYS, code="C4_FREEZE_SCHEMA")
""",
        """    mapping = document if isinstance(document, dict) else _require_closed_object(document, _FREEZE_KEYS, code="C4_FREEZE_SCHEMA")
""",
        extra,
        "F3 dropped closed-object freeze check",
    )

    original_cli = CLI.read_bytes()
    try:
        text = original_cli.decode()
        start = text.index("def _announce_pass")
        end = text.index("def main(")
        stub = (
            "def _announce_pass(message: str) -> int:\n"
            "    print(message)\n"
            "    return 0\n\n\n"
        )
        CLI.write_text(text[:start] + stub + text[end:])
        red = _run(closed)
        _assert_red(red, "SP1 original CLI closed-stdout")
    finally:
        CLI.write_bytes(original_cli)
        if CLI.read_bytes() != original_cli:

    print("RED SP1 original CLI closed-stdout")
    print("C4_R1_MUTANTS_KILLED_AND_RESTORED")
